nodes.label: Cart
nodes.what: The page where a shopper reviews items and starts checkout.
nodes.how: Sends the cart id to the checkout API and redirects to the payment step.

nodes.label: Checkout API
nodes.what: Server endpoint that turns a cart into a priced order.
nodes.when: Called by the cart page with a cart id.
nodes.how: Validates stock, prices the order, computes tax, then ==creates a pending order== and a payment intent.

nodes.label: Payment provider
nodes.when: The API creates a payment intent; the shopper confirms on the payment step.
nodes.how: Charges the card and calls back through a webhook.

nodes.label: Payment webhook
nodes.when: The provider confirms or fails a charge.
nodes.how: Marks the order paid or failed and queues the confirmation email.

nodes.label: Orders DB
nodes.when: Written at order creation and on every payment result.

nodes.label: Confirmation email
nodes.what: Background job that emails the receipt.
nodes.how: Renders the receipt template and sends it through the mail service.

nodes.label: Stock check
nodes.what: Confirms every line item is still in stock.
nodes.when: First step of the checkout API.
nodes.how: Reads inventory per SKU and rejects the cart if any item is short.

nodes.label: Pricing
nodes.how: Looks up current prices and applies any coupon on the cart.

nodes.label: Tax
nodes.what: Computes tax for the shipping address.
nodes.how: Calls the tax table for the address region.
